evidence_quotes.O: As an avid Scanner fan with assorted Uniden (and other brand) scanners, I always lusted after a dedicated short wave radio.
evidence_quotes.C: I read literally hundreds of reviews of everything I could find.
evidence_quotes.E: Being retired makes an old guy do LOTS of things to break the boredom & monotony you find.
evidence_quotes.A: For the past 2 years, I keep getting the usual calls from politicians, banks and other low life trying to sell me crap I don't want OR need....
evidence_quotes.N: I literally got so fed up I tossed this piece of junk into the trash.
